world_ds.preview_accuracy: Uses supplied approximate software mixes of original samples; no new synthesis. Source previews are not hardware-bit-exact.
world_ds.assignment_note: Region, battle and victory assignments are original Venom NXT choices; numeric source names do not identify official map music.
world_ds.conversion: Original sequence loop range, 2 ms click-prevention taper, RMS target -18 dBFS bounded by -2 dBFS source peak, stereo Ogg Vorbis quality 6. All outputs decoded and checked for clipping.
